mapper.sql: id, equipment_id, equipment_name, fault_type, alert_description, alert_level, alert_status, occurrence_time, acknowledge_time, resolve_time, handler_id, handle_result, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAlerts, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acknowledged, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = '紧急' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgent, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = '高' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = '中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_level = '低' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN resolve_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, occurrence_time, resolve_time) END), 1) AS avgResolveMinutes FROM alert WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT fault_type AS faultType, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolvedCount FROM alert WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY fault_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(occurrence_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS hourBucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND occurrence_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY hourBucket ORDER BY hourBucket ASC

SELECT id, equipment_id AS equipmentId, equipment_name AS equipmentName, fault_type AS faultType, alert_description AS alertDescription, alert_level AS alertLevel, alert_status AS alertStatus, occurrence_time AS occurrenceTime FROM alert WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY occurrence_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
